name: metamech-web
description: Canonical MetaMech Solutions website monorepo workspace

scripts.build: npm run build -w @metamech/brand && npm run build -w @metamech/shared && npm run build -w @metamech/ui && npm run build -w @metamech/corporate && npm run build -w @metamech/mdat && npm run build -w @metamech/simulation-marketing && npm run build -w @metamech/goldmeta-marketing
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @metamech/corporate --if-present && npm run lint -w @metamech/mdat --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @metamech/corporate --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @metamech/mdat --if-present
